note: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Grill the sausages over hot coals or a barbecue, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Fry the onions in the oil until soft and sweet.
Grill the corn and brush with butter.
Serve the sausages in rolls with the onions, mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and cinnamon, saffron basmati rice

steps.text: Rub the lamb with garlic, cumin, cinnamon, salt and oil.
Roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Rest the lamb.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan.
Cook the basmati with the saffron.
Pile the lamb over the rice and scatter with almonds.

note: Pinto beans simmered with bacon, molasses, mustard and smoked paprika

steps.text: Dice the bacon and onion. Drain the beans.
Fry the bacon and onion in a heavy pot until golden.
Add the beans, tomatoes, molasses, mustard, paprika and water and simmer until thick.
For the cornbread, mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk, egg and melted butter.
Pour into a hot buttered pan and bake at 220C.

note: Chili and achiote marinated pork with pineapple in small tortillas

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: fresh pineapple, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with achiote, pineapple and vinegar.
Coat the sliced pork in the marinade.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Roast at 200C until cooked through and caramelised.
Slice the pork and crisp it in a hot pan.
Serve in the tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.

note: Garlic and rosemary roast lamb leg, roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas, gravy

dish.n: "As fast as a leopard" lamb roast

steps.text: Stud the lamb with sliced garlic and rosemary. Peel and cut the potatoes and pumpkin.
Roast the lamb at 180C until 58C inside, adding the potatoes and pumpkin for the last hour.
Rest the lamb under foil.
Cook the peas, and make gravy by simmering the pan juices with the stock.

note: Spiced beef mince tacos in crisp shells with toppings

steps.text: Brown the mince with the cumin and paprika.
Stir in the tomato paste and water and simmer.
Shred the lettuce, dice the tomato and grate the cheddar.
Warm the taco shells.
Set everything out so everyone builds their own.

note: Pan-fried pork chops in apple mustard sauce, mashed potatoes, green beans

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Season the chops and pan fry on each side.
Fry the onion and apple in the pan, add the stock and mustard and reduce.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.
Steam the green beans.
Serve the chops with the sauce, mash and beans.

film: Once Upon a Time in America (1984)
note: slow braised with onions and gravy

dish.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead, slice cold and reheat in the gravy

steps.text: Season the brisket and sear hard on all sides.
Spread the onions in a roasting dish and sit the brisket on top. Pour over the stock whisked with tomato paste and paprika.
Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours.
Rest for 20 minutes, slice against the grain.
Boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy.

note: Pan-fried crab cakes with paprika chips and slaw

dish.make_ahead: Cakes up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Mix the crab with mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, Worcestershire, celery salt, paprika, parsley and panko.
Shape into cakes.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden each side.
Bake the chips and toss with paprika salt.
Toss shredded cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Serve with lemon wedges.

note: Whole roast chicken stuffed with lemon, garlic and thyme

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Rub the chicken with the soft butter, salt and pepper and stuff with the halved lemon, the garlic cloves and thyme.
Toss the potatoes and the carrots in chunks with oil and salt around it.
Roast 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the vegetables once.
Rest the chicken 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer 3 minutes for gravy.

note: Lime chili snapper grilled in banana leaf, with coconut rice and black beans

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

steps.text: Rub the snapper with the lime juice, garlic, chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf.
Grill for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Warm the black beans.
Serve the fish in its leaf.

note: Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with tomato, cucumber, olive and feta salad

dish.n: Charlie's lemon chicken and Greek salad
dish.make_ahead: Chicken can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the juice of one lemon, the garlic and oregano.
Marinate in the fridge for an hour.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta for a Greek salad, with lemon juice.
Warm the pita and serve everything together.

note: Sticky roast drumsticks in honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika

steps.text: Toss the chicken drumsticks with the honey, the chilli flakes, the smoked paprika, the oil and salt.
Roast at 200C for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.

note: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs

dish.make_ahead: Pork can braise a day ahead

steps.text: Put the pork in a pot with soy and water.
Braise gently until tender, then slice.
Soft-boil the eggs.
Whisk the miso into the hot stock for the broth and cook the noodles.
Build bowls with noodles, pork, halved eggs, nori and spring onion.

note: Whole snapper steamed with ginger, topped with soy, scallion and sizzling oil

dish.n: Yu Shu Lien's steamed whole fish

steps.text: Score the snapper and slice the ginger and spring onions.
Lay the fish on sliced ginger and spring onion.
Steam until the flesh flakes.
Pile shredded spring onion and coriander on top.
Pour over soy, then smoking hot oil so it sizzles.

note: Clove studded leg ham glazed with honey and Dijon mustard

dish.n: Claus family honey mustard glazed ham

steps.text: Remove the rind from the ham, score the fat in a diamond pattern and stud with cloves.
Simmer the honey, mustard, sugar and orange juice for the glaze.
Bake the ham at 180C, brushing with glaze every so often. Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.
Toss the beans and broccolini in butter.
Slice the ham thickly to serve.

note: Sirloin seared and basted with garlic butter and thyme

steps.text: Season the steaks well. Sear in a hot pan, turning once.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste.
Rest the steaks, then slice. Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.

note: Lamb neck slow-cooked with potatoes, carrots and thyme

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the potatoes, carrots and onion.
Layer the lamb, potatoes, carrots and onion in a heavy pot with thyme, salt and pepper.
Add the stock, cover and simmer until the potatoes break down and thicken it.
Serve in deep bowls.

note: Harry wants the cellar, Ben wants upstairs

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Cut the beef and season it
Brown in batches in a heavy casserole
Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, stock and thyme
Cover and braise at 160C, stirring once, until the beef is tender
Serve with crusty bread for soaking up the stock

note: Poached eggs and hollandaise on toasted English muffins

dish.make_ahead: Hollandaise is best fresh, keep warm up to 30 minutes

ingredients.item: eggs (3 yolks for the sauce, 8 for poaching)

steps.text: Melt the butter.
Whisk the 3 yolks with lemon juice over a gentle simmer, then slowly pour in the butter until thick.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water.
Toast the muffins and top with ham and the eggs.
Spoon over the hollandaise and finish with chives.

note: Buttermilk soaked drumsticks in paprika flour, fried crisp

dish.make_ahead: Soak the night before, fry fresh

steps.text: Soak the drumsticks in buttermilk in the fridge overnight, which happens the night before and is not counted here.
Dredge the drumsticks in flour seasoned with smoked paprika and salt.
Boil the potatoes for the mash and mash with butter.
Fry the chicken at 170C until crisp and cooked through.
Make a gravy by thickening the stock with flour in a saucepan.

note: Spaghetti with beef meat sauce, parmesan and basil

steps.text: Chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the mince with the onion and garlic.
Add the passata and oregano and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated parmesan and basil.

note: Slow roast achiote pork shredded into corn tortillas, lime pickled onion

dish.make_ahead: Pork can be cooked 1 day ahead

steps.text: Rub the pork with the achiote paste, orange juice and crushed garlic and marinate in the fridge overnight, or at least an hour if short on time.
Wrap the pork tightly in foil and roast at 160C until falling apart.
Slice the red onion thin and quick-pickle in lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Shred the pork in its juices and warm the tortillas.
Serve in tortillas with the pickled onion and habanero salsa.

note: Pork shoulder braised in roasted green chili and tomatillo sauce, over rice

steps.text: Brown the pork in batches.
Char the chillies and tomatillos.
Blitz with onion, garlic and cumin.
Braise the pork in the sauce until it falls apart.
Cook the rice and serve the pork over it.

note: Beef chuck braised with bacon, baby onions and mushrooms

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the bacon and beef and peel the baby onions.
Brown the bacon, then the beef in batches.
Add the onions and mushrooms and colour lightly.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the stock, balsamic vinegar, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer until the beef is tender.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and warm milk.
Serve the braise over the mash with crusty bread.

note: Sushi rice topped with sashimi salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then season with the rice vinegar and sugar and cool slightly.
Slice the salmon, avocados and cucumber. Cook the edamame.
Mix the soy with the sesame oil.
Top bowls of rice with salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and dress.

note: Lime chilli chicken over rice with avocado, corn and black beans

steps.text: Mix the chicken with lime juice, chilli and salt.
Marinate the chicken.
Grill the chicken until cooked through.
Slice the chicken.
Cook the rice.
Build bowls of rice with chicken, sliced avocado, corn, black beans and a spoon of salsa.

note: Hot dogs with cheddar sauce, corn relish and crispy onions

dish.n: Fred O'Hare's Hollywood loaded hot dogs

steps.text: Simmer the frankfurts, then grill until marked.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then stir in the cheddar.
Mix the corn with the relish.
Toast the buns and fill with frankfurts, cheese sauce, corn relish and tomato sauce.
Top with crispy fried onions.

note: Crisp fried pork belly wok tossed with garlic, chili and Sichuan pepper salt

dish.n: Axe Gang salt and pepper pork

steps.text: Cut the pork into strips and toss in the potato starch. Slice the garlic, chillies and spring onions.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Cook the rice.
Grind the Sichuan pepper with the salt. Wok-toss the pork with the garlic, chillies, spring onion and salted pepper.

note: Sticky soy chicken, thin omelette, peas and pickled ginger on rice

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice.
Fry the chicken thighs, then glaze with the soy and the sugar until sticky.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of sugar and roll into a thin omelette in a pan.
Pack each box with rice topped with peas, sliced chicken, omelette and pickled ginger.

note: Frank in a steamed bun with beef chili, mustard and diced white onion

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the onions, keeping half for topping.
Brown the mince with half the onion, chilli powder and cumin.
Add the water and simmer until loose and saucy.
Griddle the franks and steam the buns.
Fill the buns with franks and top with chilli, mustard and diced raw onion.

film: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019)
note: Fish, shrimp and mussels in a saffron fennel tomato broth

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Soften the fennel and garlic in the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes and wine.
Simmer to a rich broth.
Add the fish, prawns and mussels, cover and cook until the mussels open.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

film: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies (2014)
note: Roast beef sirloin with Yorkshire puddings baked in a muffin tin

dish.n: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings

steps.text: Take the beef out of the fridge, season well and make the batter by whisking flour, eggs and milk. Rest the batter while the beef cooks.
Roast the beef at 220C.
Drop to 180C and keep roasting.
Rest the beef under foil, then heat oil in a muffin tin at 230C.
Pour the batter into the hot tin and bake until puffed and golden.
Make gravy from the pan juices and stock, then carve the beef.

note: Goat or lamb braised with onion, carrot, garlic, thyme and bay

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

ingredients.item: goat or lamb shoulder, in big pieces

steps.text: Brown the meat in oil in batches
Soften the onions, carrots and garlic
Add the stock, thyme and bay leaves
Cover and braise at 160C until it falls apart
Serve with crusty bread

note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours in dark beer and Dijon, crisp double-fried fries

dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Cook the onions slowly.
Add the beer, thyme, bay leaves and mustard and braise at 160C.
Fry the potatoes at 140C, then again at 180C until crisp.
Serve the stew with the frites.

note: Brined turkey breast, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy and cranberry sauce

dish.n: Diner roast turkey with stuffing and gravy
dish.make_ahead: Rest 20 minutes before carving

steps.text: Brine the turkey for a few hours.
Roast at 170C until it reaches 70C inside.
Bake the stuffing mix in a dish alongside.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.
Make gravy from the pan juices, flour and stock.
Serve with cranberry sauce.

note: the birthday party Vianne cooks for Armande

dish.make_ahead: Salt the duck the day before, confit up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Rub the duck legs with salt, thyme and garlic.
Cure in the fridge overnight (included in cook time).
Rinse and dry the legs and arrange in a snug dish.
Cook slowly in their own fat at 140C for 2.5 hours until very tender.
Cut the potatoes, toss in some of the fat and roast at 200C until golden.
Crisp the legs skin side down in a hot pan and serve with potatoes and a green salad.
Split the lobster tails lengthways.
Melt the butter with the garlic and chopped parsley and brush over the lobster flesh.
Grill the lobster flesh side up for 6 to 8 minutes until just white.
Whisk the juice of the lemons with the olive oil into a vinaigrette, toss the salad leaves and serve alongside.

film: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)
note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours in ale with carrots, served with crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots with the thyme.
Return the beef, add the ale and stock, cover and braise at 160C.
Serve with crusty bread and butter.

note: Chicken thigh skewers grilled and brushed with soy and mirin glaze

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Dice the chicken and thread onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces.
Cook the rice.
Grill over high heat, brushing with tare.

note: Cosmo's dinner with Mona

steps.text: Slice the chicken in half horizontally and pound thin.
Dust in flour and sear in the oil and butter for 2 minutes a side, then set aside.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.
Return the chicken to coat.

note: Charcoal beef sausages and rump steak, fried onions, mayo potato salad, white bread

dish.n: Dampier sausages, steak and potato salad
dish.make_ahead: Potato salad up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives.
Grill the sausages and steaks over hot coals.
Fry the onions on the hotplate until golden.
Serve with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

note: Salami, ham, provolone, pickles and mustard on a long roll, pressed flat and crisp

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mustard.
Layer with salami, ham, provolone and pickles.
Press hard in a sandwich press or heavy pan with a weight on top until flat, crisp and melted.
Cut in half to serve.

note: ricotta and a mozzarella crust, the kind of thing a young family stretches over a week

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; add 10 minutes to the bake

steps.text: Squeeze the sausage meat from the skins, brown it, add the passata and simmer.
Cook the pasta 3 minutes short of done and drain.
Mix the ricotta with the parmesan, nutmeg and parsley.
Layer pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C until blistered.

note: Roast salmon in beurre blanc with crushed baby potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt.
Season the salmon and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes.
Simmer the shallot in the wine and vinegar until a couple of tablespoons are left. Whisk in the cold butter a piece at a time over low heat.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.

note: Saucy beef mince with cheddar and pickles on slider buns

steps.text: Brown the beef mince with the diced onion and the diced green capsicum for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic cloves, the tomato sauce, the Worcestershire, the brown sugar, the mustard and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Toast the slider buns, add a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.

note: Prawns, mussels, scallops and white fish roasted in garlic butter

steps.text: Spread the seafood in a big roasting tray and dot with garlic butter.
Roast at 220C until the mussels open.
Squeeze over lemon and serve with crusty bread.

note: Stir-fried chicken with garlic, chili and Thai basil over jasmine rice, crisp fried egg

ingredients.item: chicken thigh fillets, minced or finely chopped

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it, then keep warm.
Stir-fry the chicken with the garlic and chilli in a hot wok until cooked through.
Add the fish sauce and sugar, then toss through the Thai basil.
Fry the eggs in hot oil until the edges are crisp.
Serve the chicken over rice with a fried egg on top.

note: Thin crust pizza with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, cut into squares

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with pizza sauce and top with the mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake until the crust is blistered and the cheese is bubbling.
Cut into squares for the whole family.

note: Slow-baked paprika pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, grilled corn

dish.n: Ravager barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
dish.make_ahead: Ribs can be baked a day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika and sugar and wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 150C until tender.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill.
Grill the corn until charred.
Toss the slaw mix with mayonnaise and serve.

note: Smoked sausage, potato and cabbage simmered with caraway

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onion and sausages and dice the potatoes. Shred the cabbage.
Fry the onion in a big pot, add the sausages and brown.
Add the potatoes, cabbage, caraway and stock. Simmer until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick.
Serve with crusty bread.

note: Toasted rye with pastrami, Swiss cheese and deli mustard

steps.text: Spread the rye slices with mustard and fill four of them with pastrami and Swiss cheese. Close the sandwiches.
Toast in a pan with the butter over medium heat until the cheese melts, turning once.
Cut on the diagonal and serve with pickles.

note: Chicken thighs, pumpkin, corn, kidney beans and tomato with smoked paprika

dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the chicken and pumpkin.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the pumpkin, corn, beans, tomatoes and paprika.
Simmer until thick and the pumpkin is tender.
Meanwhile mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, egg, milk and oil into a batter.
Pour into a greased tin and bake at 200C until golden.
Serve the stew with slices of cornbread.

note: Beef chuck simmered with carrots, parsnips, onion and thyme

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the beef and vegetables.
Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, carrots, parsnips, thyme and enough water to cover.
Cover and simmer gently until tender.
Season and serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

note: Beef meatballs in passata sauce, in toasted long rolls under melted provolone

dish.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days

steps.text: Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, one garlic clove and salt and roll into sixteen meatballs.
Brown in olive oil.
Add the passata, remaining garlic and a few basil leaves and simmer.
Split and toast the rolls.
Fill with meatballs and sauce, lay provolone over and grill until melted.
Finish with fresh basil.

note: the dish Charlie plates while dreaming of his own place

steps.text: Dust the veal in the seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the same pan, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through for a minute.
Serve with crusty bread.

note: Roast sirloin with roast potatoes, rich gravy and green beans

steps.text: Roast the potatoes with the oil at 200C until golden.
Roast the sirloin at 200C to 52C inside, then rest.
Reduce the beef stock to a sauce and whisk in some butter.
Steam the beans and toss in butter.

note: Chicken thighs and mushrooms in a white wine cream sauce, over mash

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and simmer.
Boil the potatoes, mash with butter and milk.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve over the mash.

note: Pork shoulder, kūmara, pumpkin and potato roasted under cabbage in foil

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat covered

steps.text: Season the pork well. Cut the kumara, pumpkin and potatoes into chunks.
Line a deep roasting tin with cabbage leaves and add the pork and vegetables. Cover with more cabbage and wrap tightly in foil.
Roast at 160C until the pork falls apart.
Rest and shred the pork, then serve with the vegetables.

note: Slow braised beef chuck and mince with tomatoes and kidney beans, sour cream

dish.make_ahead: Better made the day before

steps.text: Brown the chuck and mince in batches.
Add the chopped onion, chilli powder and cumin, then the tomatoes.
Braise gently, covered.
Add the drained kidney beans for the last stretch.
Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.

note: Rigatoni with Italian sausage, fennel, white wine and cream

steps.text: Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, remove the sausage skins, crumble the meat and brown it in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated parmesan.

note: Miso honey glazed salmon over sushi rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Mix the miso and honey and brush over the salmon.
Roast at 200C until glazed. Cook the sushi rice at the same time.
Serve the salmon over rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger.
Rub the lamb with the garlic, rosemary, smoked paprika and salt.
Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart.
Chop the tomatoes and slice the red onion for the salad.
Warm the flatbreads.
Pull the lamb apart and serve with the flatbreads, Greek yoghurt and tomato salad.

note: Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy Dijon sauce under pastry

dish.n: Prison canteen chicken and leek pie
dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the chicken in some of the butter, then add the sliced leeks and mushrooms and soften.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream, Dijon and thyme and simmer until thick.
Cool, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in the remaining butter and serve alongside.

note: Seared sirloin, cracked pepper cream sauce, crisp potatoes, buttered asparagus

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, cook steak fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks and roast at 220C until crisp.
Sear the steaks and rest.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Steam the asparagus and toss with butter.
Serve on white plates.

note: Chicken thighs braised in red grape juice with bacon and mushrooms

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and slice the mushrooms.
Brown the chicken and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the red grape juice and water to cover and simmer.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.

note: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak, sliced thin, with rice and black beans

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix lime and orange juice with crushed garlic and cumin and coat the steak.
Marinate for 2 hours.
Cook the rice and warm the beans.
Chop the tomatoes and onion for a fresh salsa.
Grill the steak over very high heat for 3 minutes a side.
Rest, then slice thinly against the grain.

note: Crisp chips under hot gravy and shredded barbecue chicken

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Shred the chicken and tear the mozzarella.
Heat the gravy until bubbling.
Pile the chips into bowls with the chicken, scatter over the mozzarella and pour the hot gravy over so the cheese goes melty.
